reader_contract.terminal_inference: Donor direction enters both the Layer 2 successor update and the early Layer 3 class-score vector; the effect is broadly distributed across comparisons and persists after excluding the development seed.
forbidden_inferences: The Layer 2 and early Layer 3 donor-transfer indices estimate the same biological quantity.
The visual difference between the two endpoint rows is an inferential Layer 2 versus Layer 3 contrast.

The overlapping full-20 and untouched-19 cohorts are independent groups.
